import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date to datetime for time-based analysis
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Top Left: Sales by Product (Total Revenue)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
bars = ax1.barh(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors[:len(product_sales)])
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Total Revenue by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
# Add value labels on bars
for bar, val in zip(bars, product_sales.values):
    ax1.text(val + 50, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'${val:,.0f}', 
             va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Top Right: Sales by Customer Age Group
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum()
# Reorder age groups logically
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales = age_sales.reindex([a for a in age_order if a in age_sales.index])
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(age_sales.values, labels=age_sales.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors[:len(age_sales)],
                                    explode=[0.02]*len(age_sales))
ax2.set_title('Revenue Distribution by Customer Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Bottom Left: Payment Method by Product (Stacked Bar)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
payment_product = df.groupby(['product', 'payment_method'])['quantity'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
payment_product.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax3, color=colors[:len(payment_product.columns)])
ax3.set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Total Quantity Sold', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Quantity Sold by Product & Payment Method', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Payment Method', bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 4. Bottom Right: Average Transaction by Size and Takeaway Status
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df['takeaway_status'] = df['is_takeaway'].map({1: 'Takeaway', 0: 'Dine-in'})
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
df['size'] = pd.Categorical(df['size'], categories=size_order, ordered=True)
avg_by_size_takeaway = df.groupby(['size', 'takeaway_status'])['total'].mean().unstack()
avg_by_size_takeaway.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=[colors[0], colors[3]], width=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Average Transaction Value ($)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Average Transaction by Size & Order Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Order Type')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)
# Add value labels
for container in ax4.containers:
    ax4.bar_label(container, fmt='$%.2f', fontsize=8)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
